author: National Geographic
description:
Welcome to the kiln train! Continuing on his Maine adventures, National Geographic Explorer and photographer Kiliii Yüyan visits a local potter who utilizes materials from within 20 miles of the kiln. Discover how his work showcases the beauty of the natural environment of Maine. 

Come back next week to see more of Kiliii's adventures in our Maine Mondays series.
